3Bucr2crYZvLcTYKliBnde.title: 3Bucr2crYZvLcTYKliBnde
3Bucr2crYZvLcTYKliBnde.headline: Units
3Bucr2crYZvLcTYKliBnde.content: Units represent departments, stores, regions, or any other logical grouping that makes sense to you. Approvers are assigned to units and individual users. Units also store the shipping addresses buyers can use when making purchases.

6zl4WEYwtmnh5kHKEpY9fS.title: 6zl4WEYwtmnh5kHKEpY9fS
6zl4WEYwtmnh5kHKEpY9fS.headline: Users
6zl4WEYwtmnh5kHKEpY9fS.content: Users are the buyers, approvers, managers, and administrators of your organization. Each user is assigned a role for making or approving purchases.

2aI5vQeeXjtYe5P5BNJjt6.title: 2aI5vQeeXjtYe5P5BNJjt6
2aI5vQeeXjtYe5P5BNJjt6.headline: Cost Centers
2aI5vQeeXjtYe5P5BNJjt6.content: All orders placed through your organization's purchase account are linked to a cost center for tracking purposes. Each unit can have multiple cost centers.

7yXnzIFpwhBKzuuQoETmmo.title: 7yXnzIFpwhBKzuuQoETmmo
7yXnzIFpwhBKzuuQoETmmo.headline: Budgets
7yXnzIFpwhBKzuuQoETmmo.content: Budgets are assigned to cost centers and set overall purchase limits.

2KwMYtKlJwp3g0hbJqrSA2.title: 2KwMYtKlJwp3g0hbJqrSA2
2KwMYtKlJwp3g0hbJqrSA2.headline: Purchase Limits
2KwMYtKlJwp3g0hbJqrSA2.content: Purchase limits help you control spending by defining how much buyers can spend per order or per week, month, quarter, or year. Purchase limits can be assigned to users and user groups.

1sgXvYk6JQPQFLPWpfM3fT.title: 1sgXvYk6JQPQFLPWpfM3fT
1sgXvYk6JQPQFLPWpfM3fT.headline: User Groups
1sgXvYk6JQPQFLPWpfM3fT.content: User groups allow you to group users together for the purposes of assigning purchase limits.

mkPT2YNXqvomUfGs08nT8.title: mkPT2YNXqvomUfGs08nT8
mkPT2YNXqvomUfGs08nT8.headline: Account Summaries
mkPT2YNXqvomUfGs08nT8.content: Account summaries allow you to review general information about a unit, including balances and aging summary of invoices. Here, you can also browse through a list of transaction documents for a unit.
